Turn your favorite photo into a custom MemoBrick mosaic—designed by you!

Upload your picture to our new web editor and watch it transform into brick art instantly. Adjust the colors, fine-tune the details, preview different sizes, and see exactly how your finished MemoBrick will look before ordering.

Your kit includes all the 1×1 bricks, baseplates, personalized building instructions, and tools needed to bring your memory to life. Prefer some help? Let our designers create it for you and receive a free proof before production.

Create it. Build it. Keep the memory forever.
